Step 3. By compactness of the orthogonal spectral family \(R_{01330013}\), the image is precompact in the symmetric space topology.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the exponential convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01330011 \cdot C_01330012 \cdot C_01330013\).
